## 2. General exact terminal-radiation equation

Take the one-excitation Hilbert space `C^s \oplus C^n \oplus L^2((0,Omega),domega;C^2)`, with `s` storage modes and `n` emitter modes. The two photon directions are `sigma=+1,-1`, free bath energy is multiplication by `omega >=0`, and each emitter is at propagation-time coordinate `x_j`. Define the time-independent bounded coupling

    (W q)_sigma(omega) = v(omega) sum_{j=1}^n exp(i sigma omega x_j) q_j,

with `v` nonzero a.e. on some open spectral interval and `integral |v|^2/omega < infinity`. The number-conserving Hamiltonian is

    H(t) = [ H_int(t)   W^* ]
           [ W          omega ].

The bath is initially vacuum. The *exact* radiative amplitude is

    xi_sigma(omega,T) = -i v(omega) exp(-i omega T)
                     sum_j exp(i sigma omega x_j) F_j(omega),

    F_j(z) = integral_0^T exp(i z t) q_j(t) dt.

Every `F_j` is entire in complex `z` for integrable finite-duration `q_j`. Final radiation is *exactly vacuum*, not merely absent in one output direction, iff both sums vanish on an open interval, hence identically as analytic functions of `z`.

### Two distinct emitters cannot make a nontrivial terminal echo

For `x_1 != x_2`, the two-row/two-column determinant is

    det W_phase(z) = 2i sin[z(x_1-x_2)]

up to a nonzero sign. It is nonzero on a dense subset of any real open interval. Consequently `F_1=F_2=0`, and Fourier uniqueness gives `q_1=q_2=0` almost everywhere. If storage modes communicate *only* via these emitters and have no direct storage-storage hopping, they cannot transfer a one-photon excitation exactly while restoring the continuum to vacuum in finite time.

This is an obstruction for **two distinct point-like coupling positions and both propagation directions**. It does not exclude multiport giant atoms, a chiral one-direction source, direct bypass edges, time-varying radiation coupling, or finite discrete baths.

### Three equally spaced emitters admit time-dependent cancellation

Set `x=(-tau,0,+tau)` with `tau>0`. Subtracting the two radiation equations implies `F_1(z)=F_3(z)`. The remaining equation gives

    F_2(z) = -2 cos(z tau) F_1(z).

In the time domain (zero extension outside `[0,T]`), this is *exactly*

    q_1(t)=q_3(t)=f(t),
    q_2(t)=-f(t-tau)-f(t+tau).                       (A)

## 2. Exact symmetry reduction

For emitters at x=(-tau,0,tau), with tau=1/2, let

    (W q)_sigma(omega)=v(omega)*sum_j exp(i*sigma*omega*x_j)*q_j,
    sigma=+/-; v(omega)=eta*sqrt(omega)*(1-omega/12)^2,
    0<omega<12; eta=0.01.

The two outer emitter amplitudes are identical in the exact temporal-source identity. The outer antisymmetric mode consequently never couples to the prescribed trajectory. In the active basis o=(e1+e3)/sqrt(2), c=e2 the bath has two columns

    W_(sigma,o)=sqrt(2)*v(omega)*cos(omega*tau),
    W_(sigma,c)=v(omega).

Thus the active internal space is (a,b,o,c), not (a,b,e1,e2,e3). All bath amplitudes remain present. The inactive antisymmetric emitter can be retained with a constant positive energy mu and no internal source; the restriction is an invariant subspace of a physical mirror-symmetric five-mode Hamiltonian.

Set mu=2*pi, T=12, alpha=.16, and define f(t)=[4u(1-u)]^3 for u=(t-tau)/(T-2tau) in [0,1], zero elsewhere. Define

    h_o(t)=sqrt(2)*alpha*f(t),
    h_c(t)=alpha*[f(t-tau)+f(t+tau)],
    q(t)=i*exp(-i*mu*t)*h(t).

The carrier condition mu*tau=pi ensures exactly

    q1=q3=i*alpha*exp(-i*mu*t)*f(t),
    q2=-q1(t-tau)-q1(t+tau).

This cancels the complete Fourier radiation source at t=T for both directions. Define the **actual** transient radiation

    xi(t)=-i*int_0^t exp[-i*omega*(t-s)] Wq(s) ds,

which generally is not vacuum for 0<t<T, and the positive storage norm rho=sqrt(1-||h||^2-||xi||^2). Choose storage amplitudes r=rho*(cos theta,sin theta), where theta(0)=0, theta(T)=pi/2, theta'=pi*f(t)^2/(2I), I=int f^2 dt. We use the same exact, time-dependent emitter trajectory as the previous theorem.

**Decision:** this is a genuine construction of a different cancellation mechanism
inside the declared model. It preserves finite-time storage transfer, exact final
radiation vacuum, real internal hopping, no storage-storage edge, positive energy,
and an in-band carrier. It changes the radiation interface and expands internal
control resources; it is not a solution under the old factorized-bath premises,
nor a refutation of that correctly scoped theorem. Historical priority and a
laboratory capability are not established by this review.

This is a warm follow-through from the previous source assessment. I read the
receipt, current governing proof, all three current Python files and saved JSONs.
Only the supplied main and uniform scripts were replayed, once each, in an
isolated reviewer copy. Parameters, tolerances, quadrature and scientific code
were unchanged; only absolute file paths were redirected. No new experiments,
package installations or original-source edits were performed. All seven
original hashes remained unchanged. See REPLAY_RECEIPT.json for exact provenance,
runtime versions, logs and saved-output differences.
